en: Dependent on a state that is non-conflict, non-manifesting, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-conflict, non-manifesting, and impinging, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-enmity, non-manifesting, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-enmity, non-manifesting, and impinging, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-enmity, non-manifesting, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-conflict...
A state that is non-protective, non-visible, and impinging arises by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-protective, non-visible, and impinging, there arise states that are both non-protective/non-visible/impinging and non-protective/non-visible/non-impinging by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-refuge, non-manifesting, and impinging, and a state that is non-refuge, non-manifesting, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-refuge, non-manifesting, and impinging by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. [In the root condition there are five;
in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the resultant condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
Dependent on a state that is non-refuge, non-manifesting, and non-impinging, there arises a state that is non-refuge, non-manifesting, and non-impinging by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-afflictive, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-afflictive, non-visible, and impinging, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-afflictive, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-refuge, non-visible, and impinging, by way of root condition. [Dependent on] a state that is non-afflictive, non-visible, and impinging...

Dependent on a state that is non-dispersive, non-manifesting, and non-reactive, as well as states that are non-afflictive, non-manifesting, and non-reactive, [other] states that are non-dispersive, non-manifesting, and non-reactive arise by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is both non-dispersive and non-manifesting/non-reactive, as well as a state that is non-afflictive and non-manifesting/non-reactive, a state that is non-dispersive and non-manifesting/non-reactive arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the root condition there are five; in the object condition there are two ... pe ... in the ripening condition there is one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition there are five.
(This should be expanded in full everywhere—in the section on co-nascence, ... pe ... and in the section on inquiry.

Dependent on a state that is non-retreating, non-non-illuminating, and non-reactive, there arises a state that is non-retreating, non-non-illuminating, and non-reactive, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root condition: one. In the case of predominance, conascence, mutuality, dependence, kamma …pe… path, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance conditions: one. (The full detail for all cases is as above.)
